CancelChangesHint: Puts the offline storage and Segmentation Editor settings on both tabs back to their saved values; the language is not changed. Nothing is saved.
GeneralSettingsDescription: Settings for the application as a whole, and for the Segmentation Editor.
LockedModelsWarningHelp: Open as Segmentation converts only the unlocked models of a series. With this on, a message names the locked models that will be left out before the editor opens, and offers to stop asking.
LockedModelsWarningHint: Shows which locked models Open as Segmentation will leave out, before the editor opens.
LockedModelsWarningLabel: Warn when locked models are left out of a segmentation
LockedModelsWarningSavedOff: Locked models are left out without a message.
LockedModelsWarningSavedOn: Locked models are named before the editor opens.
No hotkeys found: No hotkeys are configured for this application. Hotkeys can be configured in the application's app-config.js file.
OfflineArchiveTransferHelp: Fetches one compressed archive per series instead of one request per image. This is usually much faster over slow or high-latency connections. The copy stored on this device is the same either way.
OfflineArchiveTransferHint: Fetch each series as one archive instead of one request per image.
OfflineArchiveTransferLabel: Transfer offline copies as per-series archives
OfflineArchiveTransferSavedOff: Offline copies will be transferred one image at a time. Transfers already in progress are not affected.
OfflineArchiveTransferSavedOn: Offline copies will be transferred as one archive per series. Transfers already in progress are not affected.
OfflineRetryAttemptsHelp: How many times a single image is requested before it is reported as failed. Higher values ride out brief network problems at the cost of a slower report when something is genuinely wrong. Applies to the next transfer you start.
OfflineRetryAttemptsLabel: Attempts per image before it counts as failed (1-5)
OfflineRetryAttemptsSaved: The attempt budget per image is now {{count}}. Applies to the next transfer you start.
ResetDefaultMessage:
Preferences successfully reset to default.
You must Save to perform this action.
ResetDefaultsHint: Returns the offline storage and Segmentation Editor settings on both tabs to their defaults; the language is not changed. Nothing changes until you click Save.
SaveHint: Saves both tabs. The language, offline storage and locked-models settings go to your account; the Segmentation Editor's colours and Follow the selected segment stay in this browser for now. Everything applies at once.
SegEditorFollowSelectionHelp: When a segment is selected, the 2D views scroll to its centre and the 3D view frames its surface. Off, selecting a segment moves nothing. Also set from the segmentation table's configuration in the editor. Kept in this browser for now.
SegEditorFollowSelectionHint: Moves every view onto the segment you select.
SegEditorFollowSelectionSavedOff: Selecting a segment moves no view.
SegEditorFollowSelectionSavedOn: The views follow the segment you select.
SegEditorMeshColorAutoHint: Draws the mesh in a shade of each segment's own colour.
SegEditorMeshColorDisabledHint: Following the segment colour. Turn Mesh follows the segment colour off to pick one colour for every segment.
SegEditorMeshColorHelp: The colour the mesh (edges and vertices) of the segment being edited in 3D is drawn in. By default a much lighter or darker shade of the segment's own colour; turn Mesh follows the segment colour off to pick one colour for every segment. Also set from the swatch beside Show mesh and the Model Actions menu in the 3D toolbox. Kept in this browser for now.
SegEditorMeshColorHint: Pick one mesh colour for every segment. Opens a colour picker.
SegEditorMeshColorSavedAuto: The mesh follows each segment's colour.
SegEditorMeshColorSavedFixed: The mesh is drawn in {{color}} for every segment.
SegEditorPreviewColorHelp: The colour a 3D edit awaiting Apply is drawn in: the faces a Remove, Smooth or Repair will change, with their edges and vertices. Blender's orange by default. Also set from the swatch beside Preview in the 3D toolbox and in the Repair surface card. Kept in this browser for now.
SegEditorPreviewColorHint: Pick the colour a pending 3D edit is drawn in. Opens a colour picker.
